application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T2. London Plane – Crown reduce the overextended limb growing over the road by 4.0m 
                                  Remove dead wood 
 
T3. London Plane – Crown reduce lowest limb overhanging the road by 3.5m 
                                  Crown reduce the extremities over the building to give a clearance of 4.0m 
                                  Remove dead wood  
 
T5. London Plane – Large cavity located 3.0m from ground level. Carry out climbing inspection  
                                  and report any findings 
                                  Crown reduce the height and spread back to the previous pollard points (approx. 3.5m height and 2.0m spread)
 
T6. London Plane – Decay and brown rot located at the base of tree.
                                  Crown reduce the height and spread back to the previous pollard points (approx. 3.5m height and 2.0m spread)

Maintenance works in line with good arboricultural practice
